content: Pohl Sereksang Rom
Eri, ni eh koasoandier me se pahn sereklahng Itali, irail ahpw kihong Pohl oh pil ekei me seldier ko rehn Sulius, opiser men nan pwihnen sounpei en Rom me adaneki “Sapwellimen Sihsar Pwihn.”

Se ahpw karada pohn sohp pwoat sang Adramitium, me kaunopadahr en mwesellahng kahnimw kan me mi ni oaroahr kan en wehin Eisia; se ahpw mwesel. Aristarkus, mehn Masedonia men sang Desalonika, pil iang kiht.
Mandahn rahno se ahpw lel Saidon. Sulius me kadek ong Pohl, oh mweidohng en kohla oh tuhwong kompoakepah kan, pwe en ale sang rehrail dahme e anahne.
Se ahpw douluhlsang wasao, oh pwehki eh engsuwed se ahpw serek oh tang pahn mwetehn Saiprus.
Se kohtehla sehd me sallahng Silisia oh Pampilia oh lel Maira nan Lisia.
Wasao opisero ahpw diarada sohp pwoat sang Aleksandria me pahn seiloaklahng Itali; eri, e ahpw kidahng kiht powe.

Se ahpw senserek wawai kohla erein rahn ekei, oh nan apwal laud se ahpw lel kahnimw Naidus. Pwehki eh engsuwed, kahrehda se sohte kak inenweite, se ahpw sereklahng wasa mwele kis likin deke Krihd, oh daulih imwinsapwen Salmone.
Eri, pwehki eh apwal, se ahpw peianla limwahn sahpwo oh lel wasa kis me adaneki Kepdau Mwahu, me sohte dohsang kahnimw Lasea.
Eri, se mihmihki wasao ahnsou reirei, oh me keperiong kiht se en usehla at seiloako, pwehki ni ahnsowo eh daulihalahr Rahnen Tomw.
Pohl eri kaweidkin irail,
“Maing ko, I pehmadahr me atail seiloak sang met kohla pahn inenen keper mehlel; kepwe kan oh sohp wet pahn ohla, oh ekei kitail pahn mehla.”
Ahpw kaunen sounpeio inenen koapworopworki dahme kepin en sohpo, oh me wareneki sohpo nda, sang dahme Pohl nda.

Kepdauwo kaidehn kepdau mwahu ong sohp en peipei ie ni ahnsoun kopou. Ihme kahrehda pali tohtohn ohl ako pwungki se en mwesel oh song en lel Pihniks, ma e kak. Pihniks kepdau ehu nan Krihd, me sallahng palieir en palikapi oh paliepeng en palikapi en sahpwo, me re pahn kak peipei ie ni ahnsoun kopou.
Melimel nan Madau

Kisinieng tikitik ehu uhdo sang palieir, ohl ako ahpw kihkihong me re pahn kapwaiadahte ar koasoandio. Irail eri apihada peipwungo oh serek; re medemedewe me re pahn peianlahte oaroahr en Krihd ni uwen ar kak.
Ahpw mwurin ahnsou kis kisinieng kehlail ehu, me adaneki “Paliepeng en Palimese” ahpw ipido sang dekeo,
oh lelohng sohpo. Eri, pwehki at sohla kakohng kainenehiong sohpo nan kisiniengo, se ahpw mweidohng sohpo en iangala kisiniengo.
Se diar wasa mwele kis ni at tang palieir en kisin deke Kauda. Se ahpw doadoahk laudki at katengehdi pwohten pohn sohpo wasao pwe me apwal.
Irail eri pwekadahng pohn sohpo, oh salihedi teng. Irail masak re de loisang madepei pwoat me ekis dohsang oaroahr en Lipia. Eri, re ahpw lilidi oh mweidohng sohpo en peipeiseli.
Melimelo wie kekehlailte, oh mandahn rahno irail ahpw tapihada kesehsang kanengen sohpo,
oh ni kesiluhn rahn re uhd kesehsang dipwisoun sohpo.
Rahn tohto me se sohla kilang ketipin de usu kan, oh melimelo pil kekehlailte. Eri, se solahr koapworopworki me se pahn pitla.

Eri, mwurin ohl ako ar sohla mwengehki ahnsou reirei, Pohl ahpw kesihnenda mwohrail oh nda, “Maing ko, ma kumwail rong iehte, oh sohte mweselsang Krihd, kitail sohte pahn lel soangen apwal oh luhs pwukat.
Ahpw met I peki rehmwail kumwail en koapworopwor! Pwe sohte emen kumwail pahn mehla; sohpette me pahn ohla.
Pwe pwohng, tohnleng en Koht me sapwellimanikin ie, oh me I kin kaudokiong, pwarodo rehi
oh mahsanih, ‘Pohl ke dehr masak; ke uhdahn pahn uh mwohn Sihsar. Oh Koht, sang ni sapwellime kalahngan, e ketikihong nan pehmw mouren irail koaros me iang uhk nan seiloak wet.’
Eri, maing ko, kumwail koapworopwor! Pwe I koapworopworki me mepwukat uhdahn pahn wiawi nin duwen me I rongehr.
Ahpw kitail pahn pwungidekdahng pohn oaroahr en deke ehu.”
Ni kaeisek pahieun pwohng, melimel kehlail wet ahpw kapeikitalahng nan lepin sehd Mediderenien. Nin lukepen pwohng sehla ko ahpw mwelekihada me se kereniongehr sahpw ehu.

Irail eri pirehiong mehn katoutou ehu ni sahl apwoat oh kadaridi, oh re diarada me piht epwiki rieisek loalen wasao. Pil mwurin ahnsou kis re pil pwurehng wia soahngohte oh diarada me piht duweisek loalen wasao.
Irail masak pwe sohpo de seradahng pohn takai kan. Irail eri kadaridi peipwung pahieu sang sohpo oh kasikasik pwe wasa en rahnpeseng.
Sehla ko men tangasang sohpo, irail eri kadaridi pwoht pwoat nansedo oh mwomwmwomwe me re pahn pil kadaridi ekei peipwung sang mwohn sohpo.
Pohl ahpw ndaiong kaunen sounpeio, oh pil sounpei ko, “Ma sehla pwukat sohte pahn mihmihte pohn sohpet, kumwail sohte kak mourla.”
Sounpei ko eri lupukada sahl me poudaki pwohto—pwohto eri peilahsang ni sohpo.
Ni eh kereniongehr rahnpeseng, Pohl ahpw peki rehrail irail en tungoalla: “Met kumwail awiawihkiher rahn eisek pahieu, oh nan erein rahn pwukat kumwail sohte sair kisin tungoal kis.
Eri, I peki kumwail en tungoale mehkot me kumwail anahne pwe kumwail en kak mour. Sohte mwahn apwoat pitenmoangamwail pahn pwupwusang.”
Mwurin en Pohl eh koasoia met, e ahpw ale kisin pilawa kis, kapingkihong Koht mwohrail koaros, pilitikihpeseng, oh tapihada sakan.
Irail eri pwatietda, oh emenemen irail pil iang tungoale mehkot.
Kiht koaros me riepwiki isiakan wenemen me mi pohn sohpo.
Eri, ni emenemen kiht eh medlahr, re kesehsang pohn sohpo edin pilawa kan pwe en kamarahda.
Sohp Serada
Eri, ni eh rahnpeseng, sehla ko sohte kak kasawihada mehnia sahpw mwo, re ahpw kilangada dahu pihk ehu me mi ni oaroahro. Irail eri koasoanehdi, ma e kak, re pahn pidengkilahng sohpo wasao.
Irail eri lupukada selin peipwung kan oh kesediong nansedo. Re ahpw lapwahda selin padil en ilihl kan. Irail ahpw apihada serek me mi mwohn sohpo, pwe kisinieng en wahlong sohpo ni oaroahr.
Sohpo ahpw serada pohn madepei pwoat; mwohn sohpo eri tengala, oh sohte kak mwekid, a mwurio ahpw maropkipene iloak kan.
Eri, sounpei ko ahpw koasoanehdi me re pahn kemehla me selidi koaros, pwe re de papolong nan sahpw oh tangdoaui.
Ahpw kaunen sounpeio men kapitala Pohl; eri, e sohte mweidohng irail. Ahpw e padahkihong irail koaros me kak pap re en lusisang pohn sohpo, oh papolong nan sahpw;
oh me sehse pap re en dakehda dinapw akan de kisehn sohpo. Iei duwen me kiht koaros ahpw pitkilahng nan sahpw.

footnotes.text: 27.9 RAHNEN TOMW: Rahnen tomw kin wiawi ni imwin Septempe de ni tepin Oktohpe, ni ahnsowo kisinieng kin kehlail oh kin keper seiloak nan madau.
